end.summary:
Practised representing numbers 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi identified some loose ones in examples such as 13 and 14.
They counted the bundle as one item when finding the total, such as saying 1 bundle and 3 sticks makes 4.
The bundle-counting mix-up remained at the end of the lesson; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised showing numbers 11–20 with one group of ten and extra ones. The useful method was naming the ten bundle separately from the loose sticks, and they identified the extra ones in several examples. They sometimes counted the bundle as just 1 in the total, and this was not corrected by the last example. At home, build a bundle of 10 objects and add loose objects, then count all objects together to check numbers like 13 and 14.
